title: Polynomial-time repeated pairwise transformation
statement: Let $g$ be a polynomial-time computable function on bit strings. The function that iterates the specified pairwise transformation $|S|+2$ times on an input $S$, applies the associated chunk function at each iterate for indices from $0$ through $|S|+1$, and concatenates the resulting chunks is polynomial-time computable.
